research.searchCoverage: Official Superhuman Docs API and security documentation reviewed for product scope, authentication and disclosed incidents as of 2026-09-12.

Official API, trust, migration notice, former Coda and Superhuman Docs identities reviewed. Migration notice preserves coda.io API. No qualifying breach found in reviewed coverage as of date. Identities searched: Coda; Superhuman Docs.

score.justification: Useful document and table integration demand; official API is documented; bounded reads are testable.
